titles: Elevated payment failure rate on payment-api
payment-api circuit breaker tripped on gateway calls
payment-api 3DS challenge flow failing for EU cards
Apple Pay sessions rejected by payment-api
payment-api fraud scoring latency blocking authorizations
Webhook callbacks from payment-api not reaching merchants

descriptions: Customers report failed card charges at checkout since the morning deploy. payment-api error logs show elevated gateway timeouts concentrated on Visa transactions during peak hours. Support volume has doubled and the checkout funnel conversion rate dropped sharply.

Monitoring alerts on payment-api 5xx rate exceeded threshold for the past 45 minutes. Failures are concentrated on Visa transactions during peak hours and correlate with a recent config change to gateway endpoints. Checkout latency p99 jumped from 800ms to 4s under load.

Support queue spiked for double billing on the same order within seconds. payment-api idempotency keys may not be enforced on client retries after the last mobile app release. Finance flagged 340 duplicate capture events in the last two hours.

Tokenization calls from payment-api failing with upstream vault errors since midnight UTC. Affects all new payment sessions including guest checkout and saved-card flows. PCI scope teams were notified because raw card data cannot be vaulted.

Checkout service reports payment-api returning 502 Bad Gateway on authorize calls. Load balancer health checks pass but application threads appear blocked waiting on gateway responses. Mobile and web checkout are both impacted.

Refund requests stuck in pending state for over six hours. payment-api queue consumer lagging behind producer volume after a surge in cancellation requests. Customer support cannot manually override stuck refunds through the admin portal.

Gateway health checks failing intermittently on the primary provider. payment-api circuit breaker opening and blocking transactions even when the secondary gateway is healthy. Failover logic may not be triggering as designed.

Nightly settlement job reported partial failures across two merchant accounts. payment-api reconciliation counts do not match gateway totals and the variance exceeds the finance tolerance threshold. Accounting cannot close the day until totals align.

EU cardholders fail at the 3DS challenge step with opaque error codes. payment-api logs show challenge redirect URLs expiring before customers complete authentication. Strong Customer Authentication compliance is at risk for affected transactions.

Apple Pay token validation fails immediately after wallet selection. payment-api rejects merchant session certificates with signature mismatch errors. iOS checkout is effectively down while web card entry still works intermittently.

Fraud scoring calls add 2-3 seconds to every authorization attempt. payment-api blocks the payment thread pool while waiting on the risk engine under flash-sale traffic. Legitimate customers abandon carts when authorization exceeds ten seconds.

Merchant webhook endpoints report zero payment status events since 03:00 UTC. payment-api outbound callback dispatcher shows retry exhaustion in logs without surfacing alerts. Merchants cannot reconcile orders against actual capture outcomes.

Multi-currency checkout totals disagree with cart service by one cent on roughly 8% of orders. payment-api currency conversion rounding differs from the pricing service mid-rate table. Finance disputes are opening for cross-border transactions.

ACH debit batch submission fails validation on routing number checksums. payment-api rejects entire batches when a single row fails schema validation. Payroll and subscription renewals depending on ACH are delayed.

Production traffic intermittently hits sandbox gateway credentials after a secret rotation. payment-api environment variable mapping pointed staging keys at the live deployment slot. Real charges may have been attempted against test endpoints.

descriptions: Users cannot log in across web and mobile since the Redis failover event. auth-service logs show session store connection refused on three of four nodes. Login success rate dropped below 40% and support tickets are flooding in.

Mobile clients report invalid_grant on token refresh after the weekend deploy. auth-service OAuth endpoint error rate elevated and refresh attempts fail consistently for long-lived sessions. Users are forced to re-authenticate multiple times per day.

MFA step hangs for 30+ seconds before timing out with a generic error. auth-service SMS provider callback latency appears degraded and TOTP validation succeeds only intermittently. Security team flagged increased account lockouts during the window.

Session lookups failing with timeout errors across all regions. auth-service cannot reach the distributed session cache cluster after a network partition. Authenticated users are logged out unexpectedly during active sessions.

Enterprise SSO users stuck in redirect loop between IdP and application. auth-service SAML assertion validation may be misconfigured after certificate rotation. Affected tenants cannot access admin consoles at all.

API gateways logging high 401 volume on previously valid bearer tokens. auth-service token validation rejecting tokens issued before the key rotation window. Downstream microservices report widespread authorization failures.

Services report invalid signature on JWTs minted in the last hour. auth-service may have rotated signing keys without downstream sync to JWKS endpoints. Token introspection succeeds but local validation fails.

Password reset flow broken for users requesting links via email. auth-service reset token generation failing silently in error logs without user-facing feedback. Security audit noted incomplete reset attempts with no audit trail entries.

Legitimate users locked out after a few failed attempts from shared NAT IPs. auth-service brute-force detector treats corporate egress as a single attacker. Help desk cannot bulk-unlock without manual database edits.

Refresh token rotation rejects the new token pair on first use. auth-service race between mobile background refresh and web session causes invalid_grant cascades. Multi-device users lose all sessions simultaneously.

OIDC clients fail startup because discovery document lists retired endpoints. auth-service cached metadata was not invalidated after ingress URL change. Third-party integrations cannot obtain authorization or token URLs.

Corporate device trust enrollment returns 500 during certificate upload. auth-service device registry rejects valid client certs with unknown issuer errors. Conditional access policies block untrusted devices from all resources.

LDAP group membership sync has not run in 18 hours. auth-service scheduled job stuck in running state without progress logs. Role changes in Active Directory are not reflected in application permissions.

Magic link emails arrive but links report expired on first click. auth-service clock skew between token issuer and validation nodes invalidates one-time tokens immediately. Passwordless login path is unusable.

Internal batch jobs receive 429 from auth-service token endpoint. auth-service global rate limit applies to service account client IDs without exemption. Nightly ETL pipelines fail authentication across the fleet.

descriptions: Users see outdated profile pictures after upload even though storage confirms the new file. user-profile-api CDN cache headers may be incorrect following the edge config deploy. Mobile and web clients show different avatars for the same account.

Profile save returns 500 for a subset of users with international phone numbers. user-profile-api validation errors spike in logs and correlate with a new regex rule shipped yesterday. Support cannot manually patch affected records through the admin UI.

Profile page load is slow across all regions with p95 exceeding two seconds. user-profile-api database query plans regressed after statistics drift on the profiles table. Product analytics show increased bounce rate on account settings.

Mobile app missing phone and address fields that appear correctly on web. user-profile-api partial response schema regression suspected after the v2 API rollout. Client teams report deserialization failures on optional nested objects.

Updated profiles remain invisible for up to an hour after save succeeds. user-profile-api cache invalidation events are not publishing to the message bus. Read-through cache serves stale display names in downstream services.

GDPR data export requests time out before completion for large accounts. user-profile-api bulk read overloading the primary database during export windows. Legal team flagged missed regulatory deadlines for three pending requests.

Profile search endpoint returns 503 under moderate concurrent load. user-profile-api connection pool exhausted on read replicas during marketing campaign lookups. Internal tools cannot resolve users by email hash.

Support reports users seeing another person's profile data intermittently. user-profile-api duplicate key constraint warnings appear in logs alongside cache key collisions. Data integrity review escalated to engineering leadership.

Mobile clients show preferences from several days ago after in-app changes. user-profile-api event fan-out to notification and personalization services is lagging hours behind writes. Push targeting uses outdated locale and timezone values.

HR bulk import of 12,000 employee profiles fails at row 4,100 with opaque validation errors. user-profile-api import pipeline aborts the entire batch on first schema mismatch. Onboarding deadlines slip for the new regional office.

Admin API returns unmasked email and phone in list endpoints for support tier-two roles. user-profile-api PII masking middleware skipped when Accept header omits the internal flag. Compliance flagged a potential policy violation.

Username change succeeds in settings but old handles still appear in mentions and search. user-profile-api downstream projection jobs did not consume the rename event. Social features display inconsistent identity for affected users.

Read replica lag exceeds five minutes during peak traffic windows. user-profile-api serves stale employment and manager fields to authorization services. Access reviews temporarily grant incorrect permissions.

Account deletion requests remain in pending state beyond the advertised 30-day window. user-profile-api deletion orchestrator stopped advancing workflows after a dependency timeout. Users cannot confirm erasure status through self-service.

Partner CRM integration receives 429 on profile lookup during nightly sync. user-profile-api rate limit applies per API key without burst allowance for batch jobs. Partner data drift grows each night sync is throttled.

descriptions: Mobile push notifications arrive ten or more minutes late during peak usage. notification-svc worker lag is increasing and the dispatch queue depth exceeds normal by fourfold. Marketing campaigns report poor engagement because alerts land after events end.

SMS OTP codes are not delivered to users in two carrier regions. notification-svc provider API returns 429 throttling errors and retries exhaust quickly. Login and checkout flows depending on SMS verification are degraded.

In-app notification bell stays empty despite upstream triggers firing successfully. notification-svc websocket bridge disconnected from the real-time gateway cluster. Web clients still receive email copies but mobile in-app alerts are silent.

Email and push notifications show broken placeholders like {{firstName}}. notification-svc template engine fails on new variables introduced in the campaign editor. Support sees a spike in confused users receiving malformed message text.

Alert queue depth hit critical levels overnight and continues climbing. notification-svc consumers cannot keep up with the publish rate after a traffic surge. SLA dashboards show delivery latency beyond the committed fifteen-minute window.

Bulk campaign sends blocked mid-run with provider daily cap errors. notification-svc hit the SMS provider send limit unexpectedly due to duplicate batch scheduling. Time-sensitive promotions did not reach the intended audience.

Users report duplicate push alerts for the same order status change. notification-svc deduplication key may be missing on the retry path after handler timeouts. Notification fatigue complaints increased in app store reviews.

Failed notification jobs accumulate without automatic recovery. notification-svc DLQ size exceeded monitoring threshold and on-call was not paged. Operations cannot replay failures without manual intervention.

Users in APAC receive promotional pushes during local nighttime hours. notification-svc quiet hours evaluator uses account creation timezone instead of device locale. Compliance team flagged potential quiet-hours policy violations.

Rich push notifications arrive as plain text without hero images. notification-svc media CDN fetch fails with 403 on newly rotated signing keys. Campaign click-through rates dropped sharply on iOS devices.

Topic unsubscribe requests do not stop category notifications. notification-svc subscription sync to the push provider lags hours behind preference updates. Users who opted out still receive marketing topic broadcasts.

Critical account alerts should fall back to email when push fails but never send. notification-svc fallback chain skips email when push returns a soft failure code. Security-sensitive notifications are silently dropped.

Transactional OTP messages wait behind large marketing batches in the same queue. notification-svc priority lane configuration regressed and bulk traffic starves urgent sends. Authentication latency increases during campaign windows.

iOS devices stop receiving push entirely with bad device token errors. notification-svc APNs certificate expires within forty-eight hours per provider warnings. All Apple push channels risk total outage if not renewed.

New French and Japanese templates render English defaults in production. notification-svc localization bundle for fr-FR and ja-JP was not loaded in the latest deploy. Global rollout communications reach users in the wrong language.

descriptions: Product pages show wrong availability across the storefront catalog. inventory-api counts diverge from the warehouse management system by thousands of units on popular SKUs. Merchandising paused promotions because displayed stock does not match physical inventory.

Orders are accepted for items that are out of stock in the warehouse. inventory-api allowing negative quantity values after a race in the decrement path. Customer service reports a spike in cancel-and-refund tickets.

Checkout fails at the inventory hold step with gateway timeouts. inventory-api reservation endpoint timing out under concurrent flash-sale traffic. Cart abandonment metrics jumped when holds cannot be placed within three seconds.

Store inventory has not updated since early morning in two regions. inventory-api warehouse sync job is six hours behind schedule with no failure alert. Ship-from-store promises use stale quantities and oversell locally.

Nightly catalog sync failed midway leaving partial updates visible online. inventory-api bulk update rolled back only some batches due to transaction boundary bugs. Half the catalog shows new SKUs while related availability remains on old records.

Cart service logs unknown SKU errors for products visible on the site. inventory-api lookup returning 404 for valid products missing from the search index feed. Customers add items then fail at checkout validation.

Available quantity jumps unpredictably after page refresh during browsing sessions. inventory-api read cache not invalidating on write for high-churn SKUs. Shoppers see in-stock then out-of-stock without changing carts.

High conflict rate on hot SKUs during the sale event window. inventory-api optimistic locking retries exhausted and writes fail with version mismatch errors. Inventory adjustments from the warehouse queue back up.

Safety stock thresholds breached without pager alerts to operations. inventory-api alert evaluator stopped evaluating rules after a config schema migration. Replenishment orders were not triggered for fast-moving items.

Lot and expiry tracking disagrees between inventory-api and compliance reports. Serialized lot numbers attached to the wrong warehouse bin after import. Regulated products cannot ship until lot lineage is corrected.

Inter-warehouse transfer orders remain pending without allocation updates. inventory-api transfer workflow engine not advancing states when source bins confirm pick. Distribution centers show phantom available units at both ends.

Cycle count adjustments from handheld scanners reject with validation errors. inventory-api rejects variance postings above five percent without supervisor PIN that devices no longer collect. Physical counts cannot close for month-end.

Integrations paginating inventory-api results receive duplicate SKU rows across pages. Cursor stability broke when sort keys collide on tie-breaker fields. Downstream ERP sync double-counts on-hand totals.

Drop-ship vendor availability feed has not refreshed in twenty-four hours. inventory-api vendor connector silently retries against a retired endpoint. Marketplace listings show buyable items vendors cannot fulfill.

Priority customer tiers receive inventory from general pool during shortages. inventory-api allocation rules ignore tier weights after rules engine deploy. VIP SLA commitments missed on constrained SKUs.

Cancelled orders still ship from fulfillment centers hours after cancellation. order-processor cancel event not reaching the fulfillment topic due to routing misconfiguration. Customer complaints and return costs are increasing.

Order edit flow recalculates tax incorrectly after shipping address change. order-processor tax step uses stale jurisdiction from the original cart session. Customers dispute invoice totals at delivery.

Preorder release job has not promoted waiting orders since midnight. order-processor scheduled task stuck without logs after dependency version bump. Launch day inventory remains locked on unreleased SKUs.

International orders fail address validation and land in dead letter queue. order-processor validator rejects unicode district fields required in certain countries. Cross-border revenue is blocked until messages replay.

Loyalty points accrual missing on completed orders from the mobile app channel. order-processor loyalty hook skipped when checkout source header omitted. Marketing escalated member satisfaction impact.

descriptions: New products do not appear in search results hours after catalog publish. search-index ingestion consumer lagging four hours behind the product event stream. Merchandising teams cannot verify launch visibility through site search.

Search returns zero results for common category terms that worked yesterday. search-index alias may point to an empty index after a failed blue-green swap. Site search effectively down for broad discovery queries.

Cluster health shows red status on two data nodes in the primary region. search-index shard allocation failing due to disk watermark breaches. Queries still serve from survivors but redundancy is lost.

Users report irrelevant products ranking at the top of result pages. search-index scoring model change suspected after the relevance experiment flag enabled. Click-through rate on search dropped measurably in analytics.

Catalog updates appear in search results with multi-hour delay consistently. search-index bulk indexer throughput dropped after mapping change on nested attributes. Ingestion SLA breached for the third consecutive day.

Typeahead returns no suggestions while users type brand and product names. search-index completion suggester field unmapped in the new index template. Mobile search bar feels broken without autocomplete guidance.

Broad single-term queries timeout at thirty seconds under moderate traffic. search-index query load overwhelming the coordinator node without query caching. Users abandon search when spinners never resolve.

Shard recovery fails repeatedly on node three with corrupted segment errors. search-index reports unreadable segment files after unclean shutdown. Replica promotion required to restore index integrity.

Marketing synonym additions for brand aliases have no effect on results. search-index synonym filter not attached to the active analyzer chain. Queries for common misspellings still miss intended products.

Category facet filters return zero hits despite products existing in those categories. search-index keyword subfields not populated during reindex migration. Faceted navigation appears empty on listing pages.

Full reindex job failed at sixty percent completion without rollback. search-index left alias split across old and new indices with inconsistent schemas. Some queries hit outdated mappings and throw parser errors.

Personalized search ranks generic items for logged-in users with purchase history. search-index feature store sync lagging prevents fresh signals from influencing scores. Recommendation quality regressed after profile pipeline delay.

Cross-field search on title and description misses obvious keyword matches. search-index analyzer mismatch between index and query time on stemmed fields. Support searches for SKU fragments fail unexpectedly.

Store locator geo search returns shops outside the requested radius. search-index geo_point mapping uses wrong coordinate order after import fix. Local inventory promises show distant locations first.

titles: webhook-receiver rate limit blocking valid traffic
descriptions: Partner integration events stop processing during traffic bursts at top of hour. webhook-receiver returning 503 under burst load when handler pool saturates. Downstream order state diverges from partner systems until backlog clears.

Valid signed webhooks rejected with 401 unauthorized across multiple partners. webhook-receiver HMAC secret out of sync with partner after partial secret rotation. All authenticated ingress effectively blocked until secrets aligned.

Partner endpoints flooded with retry attempts exceeding their rate limits. webhook-receiver retry policy too aggressive without jitter on transient failures. Partners threaten to block our egress IPs if retry volume continues.

JSON parse failures spike after partner ships new optional fields. webhook-receiver schema change not backward compatible with strict parser settings. Events error out instead of ignoring unknown properties safely.

Legitimate partner traffic blocked as abusive by global IP rate limiter. webhook-receiver rate limit threshold too low for consolidated partner NAT egress. Critical inventory and payment events never enter processing pipeline.

Unprocessed events accumulate in dead letter storage without triage tooling. webhook-receiver DLQ size exceeded alert threshold days ago without runbook execution. Operations lacks visibility into failure categories at scale.

Partners report TLS handshake failures on webhook ingress hostname. webhook-receiver certificate expires in twenty-four hours with auto-renew stuck pending DNS validation. All new connections will fail if cert lapses.

Downstream systems observe out-of-order state transitions for same entity. webhook-receiver parallel processing breaks ordering guarantees expected by fulfillment saga. Cancel events occasionally arrive after ship confirmations.

Duplicate side effects occur when partners retry with same delivery identifier. webhook-receiver idempotency key collisions when keys hash only event type not payload. Finance sees double application of partner adjustments.

Bulk export webhooks rejected at ingress with entity too large errors. webhook-receiver body size limit unchanged while partners increased batch payloads. Nightly catalog sync from strategic partner completely blocked.

Single partner suddenly receives 403 from all webhook POST attempts. webhook-receiver IP allowlist blocking partner after they migrated to new egress range. Partner ops open sev-one until allowlist updated.

Timestamp tolerance validation rejects events with skew under five seconds. webhook-receiver clock skew check too tight relative to partner NTP drift. Valid deliveries fail signature-time validation intermittently.

Mapped internal events missing required fields after transformation layer change. webhook-receiver transformation mapping errors drop nested objects during canonicalization. Downstream consumers throw validation errors on every message.

Handler processing exceeds ingress timeout causing spurious partner retries. webhook-receiver slow handler causing 503 when database lookups block worker threads. Retry amplification worsens overall throughput collapse.

Support replayed DLQ via admin tool and created duplicate downstream writes. webhook-receiver replay tool sending duplicates without idempotency guard on manual replay. Incident widened after attempted recovery action.
